mcq_choices.choice_text: an underestimate because h is concave up
mcq_choices.rationale: The square-root function is not concave up.

mcq_choices.choice_text: an overestimate because h is concave down
mcq_choices.rationale: Since h″(x)<0, the tangent line lies above the graph, so the linearization overestimates √10.

mcq_choices.choice_text: exact because h is linear near 9
mcq_choices.rationale: Local linearity is an approximation, not exact equality.
The sign of the first derivative does not determine over- versus underestimation.

parts.prompt:
Let h(x)=√x. The tangent-line estimate at x=9 is used for √10. The estimate is

A. an underestimate because h is concave up
B. an overestimate because h is concave down
C. exact because h is linear near 9
D. an underestimate because h′(9)>0

required_evidence: Since h″(x)<0, the tangent line lies above the graph, so the linearization overestimates √10.
